verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say it supports browsing commit history and code files, and a community user confirms non-contributors read source through the web UI instead of cloning. Nothing in the pack mentions line-by-line blame, so one of the story's three elements is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of line-by-line blame in the web interface, in-depth docs on file and history browsing, and hands-on corroboration of commit-history browsing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse repository files, commit history, and line-by-line blame in the web interface

citations.quote: browsing commit history and code files
non-contributors read source through the web UI instead of cloning
Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.
